title: The Wind Tunnel Shapes Signature Database — Overview: the Signature simulation tunnel
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature simulation tunnel is a computational wind tunnel: objects are tested by simulation rather than by physical airflow, and every record says so plainly. Signature campaigns mirror the public speed ladder — vacuum and rarefied regimes through hypersonic — so a Signature shape study can be compared thought-for-thought with its public twin. The value is iteration speed: a hundred shape variants can be screened in simulation before any physical tunnel time is booked. All drag values here are simulation outputs, labeled simulated, with the method and mesh resolution recorded.
capabilities: Computational tunnel: simulation instead of physical airflow
Honest labeling: every value marked simulated
Iteration speed: screening variants before tunnel time
Method and mesh resolution recorded per run

title: The Wind Tunnel Shapes Signature Database — Signature subsonic campaign
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature subsonic campaign simulates low-speed flow over the shape catalog with panel methods and Reynolds-averaged simulations. Blockage is modeled rather than corrected — the virtual walls are part of the simulation domain — and Reynolds scaling studies show how the simulated drag moves as the flow speeds up. Campaign records store the mesh density, the turbulence model chosen, and the convergence history, because a simulation without its settings cannot be trusted or repeated.
capabilities: Panel-method and RANS subsonic simulations
Virtual walls: blockage modeled, not corrected
Reynolds scaling studies in simulation
Mesh, turbulence model, and convergence on record

title: The Wind Tunnel Shapes Signature Database — Signature supersonic campaign
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature supersonic campaign simulates Mach 1.2 to 5 flow over cones, wedges, and airfoils, capturing the bow shock standoff distance and the shock angle off oblique surfaces. The theta-beta-Mach relation is solved numerically for each wedge angle, and the simulated shock polars are compared against the public shock tables as a sanity check. Blowdown-style unsteady runs simulate the tunnel start-up transient — the seconds when the nozzle establishes clean supersonic flow.
capabilities: Bow shock standoff and oblique shock angle simulations
Numerical theta-beta-Mach solutions per wedge angle
Shock polar sanity checks against public tables
Unsteady start-up transient simulations

title: The Wind Tunnel Shapes Signature Database — Signature hypersonic campaign
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature hypersonic campaign simulates Mach 5+ flow with high-temperature gas effects: the simulation tracks dissociation of oxygen and nitrogen behind the bow shock and reports the resulting heat flux along the body. Stagnation-point heating follows the classic square-root scaling with density and velocity cubed, and the campaign records show where the simulated heating peaks on each shape. Every hypersonic run is labeled with its gas model — perfect gas, equilibrium, or nonequilibrium — because the model choice moves the answer.
capabilities: High-temperature gas effects: dissociation behind the shock
Stagnation heating scaling with density and velocity
Peak heating location per shape
Gas model labeled on every run

title: The Wind Tunnel Shapes Signature Database — Signature vacuum campaign: from vacuum upward
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature vacuum campaign starts where the air ends: direct simulation Monte Carlo methods track representative molecules colliding with the object one at a time, reproducing free-molecular drag without any continuum assumptions. As density rises the campaign hands off to slip-flow and then Navier-Stokes solvers, stitching the regimes together across the Knudsen ladder. The handoff points are validated by running both solvers in the overlap and requiring agreement before either is trusted alone.
capabilities: Direct simulation Monte Carlo for free-molecular flow
Regime handoff: DSMC to slip to Navier-Stokes
Overlap validation: both solvers must agree
Satellite drag studies from vacuum upward

title: The Wind Tunnel Shapes Signature Database — Signature shape studies
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature shape studies simulate the drag catalog shape by shape — sphere, cylinder, plate, cone, airfoil, and blended bodies — and report simulated drag coefficients beside the public measured values for comparison. Morphing studies stretch and squeeze a baseline shape through dozens of variants, mapping how drag responds to fineness ratio, nose radius, and base shape. The best morphs are promoted to detailed simulation; the worst are kept as lessons, because a database of what fails is as valuable as one of what flies.
capabilities: Simulated drag catalog beside public values
Morphing studies: fineness ratio, nose radius, base shape
Promotion of best morphs to detailed runs
Failure records kept as lessons

title: The Wind Tunnel Shapes Signature Database — Signature multi-material burns
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature multi-material burns simulate ablative heat shields charring in hypersonic flow: the surface recedes as it absorbs heat, the char layer insulates what remains, and the shape the air sees changes through the run. Mixed-material junctions — tile to blanket to metal — are modeled as steps and gaps that trip the boundary layer, with the simulated heating spike at each junction recorded. The burn records are honest about their limits: ablation chemistry is modeled, not measured, and the database says so on every record.
capabilities: Ablating surface recession simulations
Char layer insulation modeling
Junction heating spikes at material steps
Honest limits: chemistry modeled, not measured

title: The Wind Tunnel Shapes Signature Database — Signature instrument models
body: Signature edition. Original Signature-developed content; never mixed with public records. The Signature instrument models simulate the measurement chain itself: virtual strain gauges on a virtual sting balance, pressure taps sampled from the simulated flow field, and synthetic schlieren images rendered from density gradients. Noise is added honestly — the simulated balance gets the same electrical noise floor as a real one — so the database teaches what measurement uncertainty looks like before anyone books tunnel time. A measurement is only as good as its uncertainty, simulated or not.
capabilities: Virtual sting balances with honest noise floors
Pressure taps sampled from simulated fields
Synthetic schlieren from density gradients
Uncertainty taught before tunnel time
